stc.title: Arithmetic & primes
stc.note: The number-theoretic spine: primes as structure rather than as enumeration — fibonacci, chaos, the p-adic vortex, prime fractals, the arithmetic resistor.

stc.title: Invariants & operators
stc.note: What stays fixed when everything else moves: invariants, concurrency invariants, the terminal algebra of horizons, symmetry confinement, self-adjoint operators.

stc.title: Geometry & complexity
stc.note: Shape as the cause: hyperbolic space, gerbes, bent problem spaces, chaos and order, Ramanujan graphs, fair division, the shape of fairness.

stc.title: Information & intelligence
stc.note: Representation and mind: substrate intelligence, purpose as thermodynamics, the physics of thought, rhythms of encryption, reality, the speed limit of intelligence.

stc.title: Physics & foundations
stc.note: Where the argument starts: Majorana fermions, infinity, the physics of storytelling, divergent computation, and the physics/ML bridge.

labs.title: Primes & arithmetic

labs.title: Search & hardness

labs.title: Foundations
